title: Konimpex
snippet: Trade, logistics and distribution of chemical and industrial raw materials. Applications include tire manufacturing, treads and inner tubes, molded rubber products, hoses, mats and flooring, footwear, conveyor belts, cable insulation, adhesives, sealing components and membranes. Reclaimed rubber also supports sustainable raw material management and waste reduction in industrial processes. Owning warehouses in Koło (central Poland), Łódź (central Poland) and Ruda Śląska (southern Poland), we provide our customers with maintain the required level of inventory, responding to their needs flexibly. An extensive experience in the international logistics market and a dynamic team of specialists allow us to adapt the logistics offer to the customers’ requirements. CARBON BLACK We offer a wide range of carbon black grades: technical grades from groups such as N220, N234, N326, N330, N339, N347, N375, N539, N550, N650, N660, N772, N762, N774, and N990, as well as special grades used for the production of rubber products, pigment concentrates, dyes, masterbatches, and more. Carbon black is also applicable to synthetic materials' colouring. Special grades include pigment, conductive, low PAH-level grades, and carbon black, which are used in products intended for contact with food.
